This local inquiry identifies the selected server, connection and authentication state, and current versus pending settings. Auto-join reports show actual channel membership. Explicit authentication reports show complete configured file locations, never password contents, and do not open credential files.
The summary groups current servers, channel 0, joined and left channel views, queries, unread counts, mentions, pending work, and file transfers by server. Mentions are not added to unread totals.
R refreshes; Up/Down, Page Up/Page Down, Home/End scroll. Left/Right selects Refresh or Back. / opens a command prompt; cancelling it restores this snapshot. Escape returns to the originating screen.
Enter on this suggestion copies it into the command field. It must appear there for review before another Enter can execute it. Escape returns to the same suggestion.
